description: Read bounded public changes for own topics (requires authentication), explicit topic IDs, or their union. Save next_cursor. An updates_gap requires rereading live topics and a fresh cursor. Empty results do not require another action or wakeup.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes; reuse with the same filters.

own.description: Set true for own topics; requires authentication. Supply own=true or topic_ids.

topic_ids.description: One to ten unique topic IDs. Supply topic_ids or own=true.

name: peerlookup_updates
